notes:
Zone w_webster: Webster Road from the end of w_roads' mouth (its crosswalk) to the area's cut at University Hall's north-west corner, the Feliciano School of Business drop-off loop, the drive from Webster Road, the lot by University Hall and the small lot and plaza north of it. Added in the fix-up pass when the footprint was widened; edited by hand, written once by a scratch script.
Webster Road: its centre line (tracked across 17 stations in the ortho) is one arc, radius 212.27 m, centre (-107.50, 121.17), rms 0.18 m; every Webster edge is an offset v of it (v metres outward, to the north-west). South-west part (to the drive): asphalt v -3.3 to +4.3, a 1.8 m walk on the south-east side (centre v -4.0, continuing w_roads' W_road_Carlisle_E_walk). North-east part: asphalt v -4.4 to +4.3, white edge lines at v -4.05 and on an arc of 165.1 m (fitted to 10 stations, rms 0.10 m) that closes from v +3.5 to +2.9, a 1.8 m walk that bends from the crossing up to the curb and away again (v -4.7 to -7.1). East of x -221 the ground north of the road is paved (the north model's forecourt), so the asphalt runs to the footprint.
Loop: outer curb a circle of 13.45 m about (-246.85, 232.81), rms 0.10 m over 13 points read radially, leaving it on a straight run to Feliciano; the keyhole island (planted) and its mulch tail with a stall row on each side, 2.72 and 2.67 m pitch fitted to 5 and 6 lines. Lot by University Hall: north row of 6 stalls, 2.76 m pitch and 6.0 m deep, fitted to 6 lines (7th hidden by a car). The south half of the lot lies in Feliciano's shadow: no paint reads there.
Structures from the LiDAR points (the gridded dsm has a hole there; the raw class-1 returns give outline and height): the generator enclosure north of the loop (4.7 m) and two small buildings in the planted bed (3.8 m with roof units, 3.0 m).
Not drawn: the three low units (2.2-2.6 m) north of the small building, markings in the lot's shadowed half, Feliciano's west entrance apron (outside the footprint), lamps (no pole returns found).
